title: SavingFood.ai
subtitle: AI-powered food waste management
description: An AI-powered platform for revolutionizing food waste management. SavingFood.ai uses artificial intelligence to help businesses and communities reduce food waste through smart tracking, prediction, and optimization.
problem: Food waste is a massive global problem — roughly one-third of all food produced is wasted. In developing countries, the lack of tools to track, predict, and optimize food usage contributes to unnecessary waste while communities face food insecurity.
role: Built the AI-powered platform including the prediction models, waste tracking system, and the user interface for businesses and community organizations to manage their food waste reduction efforts.
approach: AI-driven approach combining prediction models for food spoilage, tracking systems for waste patterns, and optimization algorithms for inventory management. Built as a web application with a clean, accessible interface.
hardestDecision: Making the AI predictions useful without requiring extensive data input — finding the balance between prediction accuracy and the practical data entry burden on users who are often busy food service operators.
outcome: Live at sf-project-topaz.vercel.app with food waste management features.
whatIdChange: Would add integration with point-of-sale systems for automatic waste tracking, implement computer vision for food quality assessment, and add community sharing features for surplus food redistribution.
